maker: Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics Co., Ltd. (Country Garden)
model: Tie-Rod Hole Plugging Robot (螺杆洞封堵机器人)
name: Bright Dream tie-rod hole plugging robot
summary: Indoor robot that finds the tie-rod holes left in concrete walls after aluminium formwork is struck and fills them with mortar. Made by Bright Dream in Foshan.

germany.statusNote: No route for a German buyer. Bright Dream lists the robot only on its Chinese website, whose product detail pages are blank, and its global exclusive agent BrightMaster Robotics (BMR) does not offer it. No EU dealer, customer or CE marking found.

specs.label: Application
specs.value: plugging tie-rod holes indoors after aluminium formwork removal
specs.quote: 适用于铝模板拆除后，室内螺杆洞封堵施工

specs.label: Method
specs.value: vision finds the holes; own mortar plugging system fills them
specs.quote: 能够通过视觉识别墙面孔洞的位置，配合自研的砂浆封堵工艺系统，完成孔洞封堵

notes: Indoor side only; the facade side is done with semi-automatic hand tools (maker).
Mechanism and drive not described; wheels assumed.
Bright Dream says 28 of its robot types are in commercial use; this one is listed as a product, but it is not offered by BMR.
